reply.text:
I'm sorry your back is hurting. Bending over that much after a deadlift session is something a doctor or physio needs to look at, not me, so please get it checked before you load it again. I won't guess at what it is or how to ease it.

Thursday's session is off the table until someone who can examine you clears it. Once you've been seen, tell me what they say and what you can and can't do, and I'll build your training around that. Let me know if you want me to check your program's Thursday in the meantime so we know what's in it.
